title: C lichen_schc_compress reports raw-bound violation as BUFFER_TOO_SMALL
description: Codereview finding (P3) from ba39 3-pass review. lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc.c raw-packet ceiling guard (pkt_len > SCHC_FRAGMENT_MAX_PACKET_SIZE) returns SCHC_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL; a caller keying on BUFFER_TOO_SMALL to grow-and-retry would retry an undeliverable datagram. Rust/Python classify it as a profile-limit error (InvalidPacket). C has a flat error taxonomy; decide whether to add a dedicated code (e.g. SCHC_ERR_PROFILE_LIMIT) or document the conflation. Discovered-from: project-LICHEN-worker6-ba39
